open_points.subject: A5
open_points.text: and no stored image, placement record or mark record is written
open_points.question: Must this test also prove that every pre-existing stored image, placement record and mark record remains unchanged and is not deleted, or does it prohibit only writing a new or replacement record?
options: Prove that no stored image, placement record or mark record is created, replaced, modified or deleted
Prove only that none is written; deletion of existing durable state is outside this test
open_points.default_guess: Prove that all pre-existing durable state remains byte-for-byte unchanged and that none is created or deleted.

witness.initial: A confirmed project already has a stored image, placement record and publication mark; the agent then clears assignment_confirmed.
events: The calling flow invokes placement for that project.

One implementation returns immediately and preserves all existing durable state; another performs cleanup that deletes an existing stored image or record but writes no stored image, placement record or mark record.
outcomes: The refusal leaves all earlier durable state intact.
The same refusal deletes earlier durable state while satisfying the stated no-record-is-written assertion.
witness.observer: The owner or a later scan, replayed placement or mark operation sees whether the earlier placement and publication still exist.
